corpus.description: every distinct product name from out\regular + out\sams + out\bakers + out\fareway capture files dated 2026-07-23..2026-08-06 (the 14-day carry window that can reach the board) plus every store row of comparison-2026-08-05
corpus.method: full first-match-wins simulation over all 503 commodities.json rules (include then exclude, array order), BEFORE vs AFTER the rule changes below; candidates prefiltered by trigger tokens, all other names untouched by construction (no changed token can match them)
corpus.caveat: family-fare-regular-2026-08-06.json was being appended by the live FF sweep during measurement; the stable 2026-08-05 FF file was used for the aisle exposure section

rule_changes.change: exclude += 'steam\s+bags?' (fresh steam-in-bag green beans are not canned)
exclude '\bpasta\b' -> '^(?!.*\bfrozen\b).*\bpasta\b' (pasta only excludes when the name carries no frozen marker)
exclude += '\bquart\b', '\bpint\b' (commodity label is Food Storage Bags (gallon))
